show.description: At his grandfather’s funeral, billionaire CEO Lakshya Malhotra is branded a killer when two brothers accuse his charity nursing home of murder. To uncover the truth, he goes undercover as a nurse—only to find a staged “happy” facade hiding a basement hell of tortured elders, fake audits, and insiders who’ll kill him to keep the money flowing.
